name: Cedrus atlantica extract
description: Cedrus atlantica extract (CAS 92201-55-3 ), derived from the Atlas cedar tree, is sourced for its aromatic profile and functional properties across personal care, fragrance, and nutraceutical applications. Known commercially as Cedrus atlantica, ext., it delivers woody, balsamic scent characteristics that underpin its demand in fine fragrance and flavoring markets. In perfumery and fragrance formulation, it contributes base-note depth. It is used in eau de parfum, eau de toilette, and functional fragrance products such as scented candles and home care preparations. Cosmetic formulators incorporate it into hair care and scalp treatment products. Its botanical origin supports positioning in premium and natural-certified product lines. As a flavoring agent, it is used in food and beverage applications requiring woody or resinous aromatic character. This use is consistent with its FEMA -recognized status. Pharmaceutical and nutraceutical manufacturers also evaluate it as a botanical extract ingredient in standardized herbal preparations. Cedrus atlantica extract is typically supplied as a liquid extract, essential oil fraction, or resinoid, depending on the extraction method and intended application for the final product. Technical and cosmetic-grade specifications are the most commonly traded forms, with documentation aligned to IFRA guidelines for fragrance use. Food-grade supply is available for flavoring applications. All supply is subject to regional regulatory compliance requirements. The material is handled according to strict industry protocols to ensure the highest purity and consistency for industrial manufacturing.
